title: Missed-Visit Courtesy for Groom Club Monthly Members — Tailwise Grooming Salon
content:
Groom Club Monthly members of the Tailwise Grooming Salon with a short record of missed visits keep only part of a club late-cancellation charge.

**Courtesy rule.** The missed-visit courtesy on the club late-cancellation charge counts the forfeited visits and no-shows recorded on the club since it was joined, cancellation entries themselves not counting: none keeps 0.5 of the charge, exactly one keeps 0.75 of it, and two or more keep all of it.

| Forfeited visits and no-shows recorded on the club since joining | Share of the charge kept |
|---|---|
| none | 0.5 |
| exactly one | 0.75 |
| two or more | all |

The courtesy share multiplies the club late-cancellation charge.

**Counting from the club history**

| Entry in the salon history of the club | Counted |
|---|---|
| a visit forfeited | yes |
| a no-show | yes |
| a cancellation entry, with or without a remedy | no |
| a completed visit, redo or monthly billing | no |

All such entries since the club was joined count; there is no rolling window.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical members, charge of 60.00 before the courtesy)**

- A member whose club history shows no forfeit and no no-show: 60.00 multiplied by 0.5, that is 30.00.
- A member with one no-show eight months ago: 60.00 multiplied by 0.75, that is 45.00.
- A member with one forfeited visit and one no-show: 60.00 kept in full.
